Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The Risk PMO team protects Stripe’s revenue and drives cross-functional strategy for company-level and org-level priorities. As Stripe operates across an increasingly complex and fast-moving global regulatory environment, one of our most important functions is ensuring that our largest, most strategic users can grow with us—compliantly, confidently, and at speed.
We sit at the intersection of Legal, Compliance, Engineering, Product, Data Science, and GTM—serving as the bridge between teams coordinating massive programs with global, wide-reaching impact. We build durable systems that enable strong collaboration across functions and seamless experiences for our users.
If you're energized by high-stakes, ambiguous problems and thrive on building programs from scratch in environments where the rules are still being written—we want to hear from you.

You will define, own, and execute program strategies for large-scale regulatory initiatives, operating with significant autonomy across a portfolio of global projects.
This is a highly visible, senior individual contributor (IC) role. While you will influence senior leadership and set strategic direction, you are also the primary driver of execution. You will need to zoom out to design the long-term vision, and zoom in to manage the details—building templates, tracking deliverables, writing documentation, and directly unblocking cross-functional teams.

Own and execute high-stakes global programs end-to-end, from initial strategy and scoping to project planning, day-to-day tracking, and change management
Drive step-change improvements in our operational processes, rolling up your sleeves to build systems and workflows that directly improve business outcomes and top-line metrics
Bridge compliance and commercial strategy by partnering with GTM and account leadership to turn complex regulatory requirements into a competitive advantage that builds deep user trust
Build and run operating models across diverse cross-functional teams (including Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, and Compliance), keeping highly distributed workstreams aligned and accountable
Serve as a trusted advisor by preparing strategic reviews for senior stakeholders and managing critical escalations
Translate user friction into program evolution by establishing structured, data-driven approaches to gather user feedback and turning those insights into actionable product and operational improvements
Diagnose and resolve systemic operational gaps before they impact our users, building self-healing processes and scalable internal infrastructure
Champion Stripe’s Operating Principles by fostering a high-performance culture that values rigorous thinking, rapid execution, and putting users first

You are a highly strategic operator, a masterful communicator, and a systems thinker with operational grit. You thrive in the gray area, possessing the ability to translate ambiguous global challenges into elegant, structured, and highly actionable operational frameworks.
You are a natural leader who leads by influence and by example. You have a deep empathy for the user, an unyielding bias toward action, and you take pride in the craft of execution. No problem is too complex for you to deconstruct, and no detail is too small if it impacts the user experience.

10+ years of experience in Program Management, Strategy & Operations, Management Consulting, or Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
Hands-on execution track record: Proven ability to work independently as an individual contributor, managing complex, multi-stakeholder project plans and deliverables from inception to completion
Exceptional communication & storytelling: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; a proven ability to distill highly complex, technical, or regulatory topics into clear, succinct, and persuasive narratives to external and senior audiences
Systems and infrastructure builder: Deep experience designing, launching, and scaling complex cross-functional operating models, feedback loops, and PMO frameworks
Growth mindset: A high willingness to learn, adapt quickly to changing environments, and actively seek and act on feedback to continuously improve

3+ years of experience in high-growth technology or fintech environments
Deep cross-functional partnership: Prior experience working alongside Engineering, Product, Legal, Compliance, and GTM/Sales
Data fluency: Experience leveraging data visualization tools and analytical frameworks to back up strategic decisions and measure program success

The Program Manager (Branch Manager for Field Services) in the Real Estate Management Division, Facilities and Administration, Mission Support, Transportation Security Administration (TSA), Department of Homeland Security (DHS).

Duties include but are not limited to: Duties include: Provides overall leadership and supervision for the division, including planning, communicating vision and objectives, setting priorities, managing budget and resources, recruiting and developing staff, approving leave, and taking corrective/disciplinary actions.

Ensures workforce alignment with organizational goals and manages a multi-sector workforce. Leads, directs, and exercises broad authority over all phases of real estate management policies, strategic planning, and program operations for TSA.

Provides innovative leadership in establishing and implementing comprehensive real estate management strategies. Oversees activities related to TSA's leased and owned real estate portfolios, including lease acquisition, administration, facilities operations and maintenance, construction, and real estate disposition.

Supervises a team of Realty Services Managers (RSM) who direct, implement, coordinate, and oversee a national real estate program requiring a wide range of management support principles, processes and systems. The RSMs manage initiations and renewals of leases, which require a complex process of negotiations between and approvals by the parties.

Provides oversight and management direction for contracted functions, ensuring efficient and effective use of public and private resources in support of TSA's mission.

Implements policies and procedures to reduce TSA's real estate footprint through space consolidation and utilization, and operational costs by deploying energy efficiency tools, consistent with OMB guidance.

Collaborates with TSA office directors and interacts with senior leaders within TSA, DHS, GSA, and service providers to ensure operational facility requirements are prudently executed and managed.

Administers a diverse, enterprise-wide real estate portfolio, ensuring full compliance with federal leasing regulations, lease expirations, and portfolio performance metrics. Manages and executes over 500 GSA leases, ensuring terms are negotiated in the best financial interest of the agency.

Navigates the GSA Reimbursable Work Authorization process, ensuring accurate funding data, budget tracking, and timely execution of tenant improvement projects. Provides proactive, outstanding customer service and real estate solutions to field real estate locations, addressing space requirements and facility concerns and improvements.

Conducts special real estate projects and complex analyses, as assigned by the Director, requiring a comprehensive knowledge of program management. Supervisory/Managerial duties includes serving as a first line supervisor for the organization.

This includes but is not limited to: assigning work, setting priorities, and reviewing and evaluating work and performance of subordinates; approving leave; coaching and developing employees; recommending corrective or disciplinary actions; assisting in budget planning and projecting short-term needs; managing projects within assigned resources; resolving routine problems that typically impact the objectives of the organizational unit; and when required, coordinating with customers outside the immediate organization.
To qualify for the SV-K Pay Band (equivalent to GS-15), you must have one year of specialized experience at the SV-J or GS-14 in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private sector.

Specialized experience is defined as experience that has equipped you with the knowledge, skills and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the position.

Specialized experience is defined as: Knowledge of federal laws, regulations, policies, and procedures related to real estate management, leasing, facilities operations, and asset disposition. Experience in managing multi-layered, geographically dispersed organizations with varied missions and functional requirements.

Credit for experience is given based on a 40-hour workweek. Part-time experience is credited on a part-time ratio, i.e., working 20 hours per week for two months equals one month of experience. No additional credit is given for overtime.

National Service Experience (i.e., volunteer experience): Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

This position as a Natural Resource Manager, is an outstanding opportunity for a candidate with skills in Geospatial technologies, biological sciences, ecology, or other environmental sciences. Employee will serve as the Natural Resource Manager of the Ice Age National Scenic Trail (NST).

The position is in Cross Plains, Wisconsin, is supervised by the Trail Manager for the Ice Age NST, with an office building situated on NPS Property along the Ice Ace Age NST route. The NPS property is located within and makes up some acreage of the larger Cross Plains Ice Age National Scientific Reserve and State Park.

The Ice Age NST is a premier recreational footpath that generally follows the edge of the last glacial advance in Wisconsin. The Ice Age NST is administered and managed in partnership between the National Park Service (NPS), Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources (WDNR), and Ice Age Trail Alliance (IATA).

When completed, the Ice Age NST will meander for approximately 1,200 miles through Wisconsin, from Potawatomi State Park in Door County to Interstate State Park in Polk County. Today, approximately 700 miles of the Ice Age NST have been constructed and are open for use.

The Ice Age NST preserves outstanding landscapes and landscape features, resulting from continental glaciation. The National Park Service is responsible for overall administration, planning, compliance, interpretation, signage, and some land acquisition.

At the full performance level (GS-09) the major duties of this position include, but are not limited to the following: Carry out provisions of the National Trails System Act (P.L. 90-543, as amended) pertaining to the geospatial aspect of planning and administering of the Ice Age NST.

Administers all functions related to ArcGIS, technical support, and collecting data with GPS while proposing creative ways to use technology to advance development of the trail and advanced interpretation. Creates presentations of findings and effectively communicates project details to interested parties, partners, and members of the public.

Develop project workplans and implementation strategies leading to the accomplishment of restoration efforts, trail development, mitigation actions, and participate as a member of the planning and interdisciplinary team.

Interprets variables, trends, correlations, and interrelationships between data and conditions of work projects and provides reports to managers and interested parties.

Encourages and facilitates cooperation, pride, trust, and teamwork mentality that fosters the commitment to the Ice Age National Scenic Trail and supports the goals established with partners. Duties will be developmental in nature when filled below the full performance level.

Salary Range Information (Per Annum): Cross Plains, WI GS-07: $50,460 - $65,599 GS-09: $61,722 - $80,243 *First time hires to the federal government typically start at the beginning salary in the range for their respective grade level.
Requirements Continued... As a condition of employment for accepting this position, you may be required to serve a 1-year probationary period to evaluate your fitness and whether your continuation of employment advances the public interest.

This probationary period is an extension of the appointment process and therefore requires the agency to determine if continued employment would advance the public interest, meet the organization goals and mission of the agency, and/or otherwise promote the efficiency of the service.

In determining if your employment advances the public interest, the agency will consider: your performance and conduct; the needs and interests of the agency; whether your continued employment would advance organizational goals of the agency or the Government; and whether your continued employment would advance the efficiency of the Federal service.

Under applicable law, the employment of an individual serving a probationary or trial period automatically terminates when that period ends unless the agency affirmatively certifies, in writing, that the individual's employment should continue and that their appointment should be finalized.

In the absence of agency action to affirmatively certify continued employment beyond the probationary or trial period, such appointments are terminated. Upon completion of your probationary period your employment will be terminated unless you receive certification, in writing, that your continued employment advances the public interest.

The United States Space Force (USSF) at Peterson Space Force Base, Colorado is searching for a Program Manager for the MILSATCOM Product Support Delta (NH-1101-03, GS 12/13 equivalent).

Description: Leads a cross-functional team of Government and contractor personnel providing sustainment/product support for United States Space Force Military Satellite Communication programs. Manages daily program execution in an effort to ensure fielded systems meet Space Operator/user's mission requirements.

Serves as the primary interface between the Government Program Office and Prime MILSATCOM Contractors. Manages existing contracts and plans/develops requirements for future contracts. Evaluates proposals to ensure proposed level(s) of effort and costs are in-line with Government requirements.

Oversees programs' Weapons Systems Sustainment (WSS) requirements and advocates for current and future funding needs.

Ideal Candidate: Prrogram management experience, familiarity with the defense acquisition management framework, prior experience developing and managing program/system requirements, working knowledge of the various acquisition disciplines (e.g.

Financial Management, Contracting, Logistics), Bachelor's Degree (mandatory), APDP (or equivalent) Program Management certification (highly desired) Key Skills and Abilities: 1.

Knowledge of the applicable principles, concepts, policies, and laws; functions, programs, and systems applicable to the duties of logistics contracts and program management and material support; sources, responsibilities, and means for providing assistance and advice to resolve logistics contracts and program management problems; and all aspects of logistics contracts and program management support. 2.

Knowledge of government and private industry policies and practices related to business management, industrial management, financial systems, technical concepts, and production practices.

Ability to gather, analyze, and evaluate a variety of program information, such as commercial business practices, market conditions, offer acceptability, contractor acceptability, contractor responsibility and/or performance to determine acquisition strategy and sources. 3.

Knowledge of the missions, roles, functions, organizational structures, and operation of the Department of Defense and entities that govern, interface with, and/or influence management control of proposed and ongoing service contracts. 4.

Knowledge of methods of supervision to hold others accountable for measurable high-quality, timely, and cost-effective results. Ability to plan, organize, and direct the functions of a unit and mentor, motivate, and appraise subordinate staff.

Determine objectives, make sound, well-informed, and objective decisions, set priorities, cause change, and accomplish organizational goals. 5.

Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, clearly, concisely, with technical accuracy and to use computers and a variety of software programs and databases, gather and analyze a variety of program information, make sound judgments concerning program progress, and effectively communicate recommendations orally and in writing to higher organizational management and contractors. 6.

Ability to establish and maintain good relationships with individuals and groups within the office as well as outside the immediate work unit and to be persuasive in representing the best interests of the government when dealing with personnel with highly divergent points of view. 7.

Ability to plan, organize, analyze problems, translate complex information, make appropriate judgments, evaluate options, conduct research, summarize results, make appropriate recommendations, and manage critical aspects of service contract requirements as related to the assigned functional area and meet deadlines.

Ability to compose and edit contract required correspondence, review and analyze directives, develop and brief service contract program related presentations.

s.h: About the Role - Platform Operations Program Manager
s.t:
As OpenAI's developer ecosystem expands, we're building the operational foundation to support the next generation of plugins, MCP apps, agent skills, and integrations. As a Platform Operations Program Manager, you'll partner across Product, Engineering, Policy, Legal, Security, and Developer Experience to design the systems and operating models that enable ecosystem growth while maintaining quality, trust, and an exceptional developer experience.
This role requires strong operational judgment, a deep understanding of developer platforms and APIs, empathy for the developer experience, and the ability to translate evolving product, platform, and policy requirements into scalable operational systems.
Location: San Francisco, CA (Hybrid - 3 days in office)

Own the operational processes that help developers bring apps, plugins, and integrations to market, from submission and review through launch, appeals, and ongoing monitoring.
Manage external review partners and policy operations workflows, helping teams apply standards consistently while identifying areas where guidance, process, or quality expectations need to improve.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Policy, Legal, Security, Developer Experience, and Go-to-Market teams to turn platform goals and requirements into clear, effective operating processes.
Lead high-priority partner reviews and escalations, balancing speed to launch with user trust, and consistent standards.
Create feedback loops across product, policy, tooling, and developer experience teams to reduce friction for developers and improve the quality of integrations over time.
Lead automation and AI-driven initiatives, such as agentic workflows, to improve the speed, consistency, and scale review and support processes.
Serve as a senior cross-functional partner, using operational expertise and platform insights to help shape product strategy and improve how the ecosystem works.
You Might Thrive If You
Have 8+ years of experience in program management, developer operations, product operations, or related fields.
Are comfortable engaging with technical concepts such as MCP, APIs, OAuth, authentication, permissions, and data flows, even if you're not writing production code.
Exercise strong operational judgment and can balance speed, safety, and business priorities when making decisions.
Bring structure to ambiguous, cross-functional problems and drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Policy, Legal, Security, and Operations.
Think in systems rather than individual cases, identifying recurring patterns and building durable processes instead of one-off solutions.
Have experience using AI and automation to reduce manual work, improve quality, and scale operational processes.
Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences, translating complex requirements into practical guidance.
Care deeply about developer and partner experience while maintaining consistent standards that protect the platform and its users.
About OpenAI
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products.

AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

Are you a cross-functional program leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy, operations, and GTM execution? If so, invite you to join us at Elastic as a Senior Program Manager, Revenue Operations!
As a member of our team, you will lead our programs of work that span across Field Engineering and Support organizations. Where our Senior Analysts are embedded partners to their respective collaborators, you are the connective tissue: the person who defines how we work, not just within a single team, but across all of them.
The Senior Program Manager will design and drive the operational standards, execution models, and planning rhythms that enable consistent, high-quality GTM execution at scale - and for ensuring that what works in one org finds its way into the others.
What you will be doing
Own the design and delivery of programs that cut across Field Engineering and Support, including annual planning, execution model development, and operational rhythm standardization
Serve as the primary owner of our canonical operating models: how we run QBRs, how we structure planning cycles, how we build feature adoption plays, how we define and communicate execution norms across geos
Coordinate fiscal year planning activities across both organizations, including headcount & allocation, quota setting, territory carve, and roll-out
Define the standard for how our internal customers operate - the rhythms, templates, and frameworks that Senior Analysts then localize for their specific org and geo
Build the feedback loop that ensures geo-specific nuance helps shape the standard rather than accumulate as silent workarounds
Partner with FE and Support management to identify gaps between how teams are operating today and how they should be operating, then design solutions that close those gaps durably
Identify cross-functional processes that are ripe for automation, and partner with Senior Analysts and systems teams to build solutions that reduce execution burden across the team
As automation creates capacity, redirect that capacity toward higher-order critical initiatives - act as a key voice in deciding where the team should spend its time
Establish repeatable communication, documentation, and training protocols that drive successful adoption of new processes, tools, and operating models
Collaborate with Sales Operations, IT, Finance, and Business Systems to identify dependencies and build comprehensive solutions

5+ years in Program Management, Revenue Operations, or GTM Strategy & Operations in a B2B SaaS organization
Proven experience running cross-functional programs that span multiple organizations
Direct exposure to Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Customer Engineering, Technical Sales, or Support organizations
Systems-level thinker: able to identify how a change in one part of an operating model creates downstream effects elsewhere
Highly organized, analytical, and data-driven; comfortable in SQL, G-Sheets, and Salesforce — able to build the analysis that supports the program
Top-notch communicator, able to transition fluently between working sessions with senior leaders and detailed execution conversations with analysts and ICs
Comfortable operating with ambiguity, proactively structuring abstract problems to drive it to a concrete outcome
BS/BA in Business, Finance, Operations, or equivalent experience
We would love for you to join our diverse Revenue Operations team!

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates.

A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ airbnb.com or @ ext.airbnb.com email addresses.

Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process.

We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

Get to Know our Team
The Customer Experience Group (CEG) of Agoda effectively serves our customers and partners to ensure satisfying results. This great task is accomplished with the support of our Global Service Verticals (GSV) team. We serve as the backbone for CEG’s global operations.

Our team is comprised of project managers, process owners, analysts, and talent management. Together we work nonstop to improve the quality and efficiency of our customer and partner support processes. We are a very data-driven environment, eager to move fast and learn through experimentation.

A clear focus on supporting our customers and partners is bolstered by a strong, entrepreneurial culture that enriches us and Agoda’s business performance.
This role is within the Partner Excellence team , which is a part of CEG’s Global Service Verticals. The team focuses on driving end‑to‑end partner experience and process improvements, and scaling impact through automation, AI, and tooling across both partner-facing and agent-facing journeys.

This role is responsible for leading a portfolio of global partner excellence programmes with a focus on complex system support in the Customer Experience Group (CEG), with a focus on: (i) process optimization and PX improvements across the post‑booking partner journey, (ii) automation, AI, and tooling to enhance customer and agent experience, (iii) collaboration with product and commercial teams to drive structural changes and (iv) reduce partner effort and CEG cost‑to‑serve, unlock commercial value from partner support insights
You will lead a high‑performing team of project managers/experts to drive measurable impact on customer satisfaction, efficiency, quality, and cost. The role combines strategic problem solving, hands‑on data-driven execution, and strong stakeholder management with both technical (Product/Tech/Data) and non‑technical (Operations/Support/Commercial) teams.

s.h: In this Role, you’ll get to
s.t:
Lead and Own a Portfolio of Transformational Initiatives
Own from end‑to‑end a collection of projects and/or areas of business in CEG (global coverage), spanning commercial enablement and process excellence initiatives.
Prioritize, plan, and drive initiatives that improve mission‑critical metrics: partner satisfaction (e.g., PSAT), service levels, automation quality, productivity, cost efficiency, and employee/agent engagement.
Ensure CEG readiness to support Agoda’s new business and product initiatives by working closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing, Strategic Partnerships, Partner Services, Finance, Legal, and other CEG teams.
Shape End‑to‑End Customer & Process Improvements
Continuously improve CEG end‑to‑end processes across the post‑booking journey to remove pain points, and improve operational performance through targeted initiatives and data driven insights.
Own and evolve frameworks and roadmaps for how we continuously improve our internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and related processes; balancing CX/PX outcomes vs. efficiency/cost.
Define clear problem statements and build business cases to define and prioritize customer/partner pain points and success metrics.
Drive Commercial driven Solutions & Insights in Operations
Partner with Product Management / Technology /CEG teams to design, prioritize, and implement solutions, from experimentation and configuration through to global rollout and impact measurement.
Drive strategic initiatives across CEG such as improving complex systems support in key growth markets, regulatory initiatives and partner closely with our commercial teams in order to improve partner/supplier pain points.
Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI, and tooling across customer, partner and agent journeys (e.g., self‑service, post-booking APIs).
Lead and Develop a High‑Performing Team
Set long‑term vision, strategy, and annual/quarterly OKRs for your team, aligning with CEG and Agoda-wide priorities.
Manage and coach a team of project managers (and potentially people managers), building talent, capability, and succession within the Partner Excellence team.
Provide structured feedback, mentoring, and support to enable your team’s growth and to consistently raise the bar for quality and impact.
Build trusted relationships with senior leaders and stakeholders across CEG and other functions, effectively influencing priorities and decisions.
Monitor project milestones, identify risks and dependencies, troubleshoot issues, and implement mitigation plans—acting at all times as the ultimate owner of the portfolio’s outcomes.

Experience & Background
At least 8–10+ years of experience in project/program management, strategy & operations, commercial excellence, process improvement, management consulting, or similar fields.
Significant people leadership experience, including building and managing high‑performing teams (ideally including people managers and individual contributors).
Proven track record of leading and influencing complex, cross‑functional initiatives from idea to implementation, with clear, measurable business impact.
Experience working closely with Product/Technology/Data teams on technical or automation/AI-focused projects is highly advantageous.
Technical & Analytical Skills
Strong analytical mindset; comfortable with numbers and quantitative problem solving. Able to define analysis structures, interpret data, challenge existing metrics, and make recommendations.
Familiarity with data and analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Tableau, Metabase, VBA, or similar) and experience leveraging them to drive decisions.

To qualify for this position, you must meet the basic requirements as well as any additional requirements (if applicable) listed in the job announcement. Applicants pending the completion of training or license requirements may be referred and tentatively selected but may not be hired until all requirements are met.

Currently employed physician(s) in VA who met the requirements for appointment under the previous qualification standard at the time of their initial appointment are deemed to have met the basic requirements of the occupation.

Basic Requirements: United States Citizenship: Non-citizens may only be appointed when it is not possible to recruit qualified citizens in accordance with VA Policy. Degree of doctor of medicine or an equivalent degree resulting from a course of education in allopathic medicine or osteopathic medicine.

The degree must have been obtained from one of the schools approved by the Department of Veterans Affairs for the year in which the course of study was completed. Current, full and unrestricted license to practice medicine or surgery in a State, Territory, or Commonwealth of the United States, or in the District of Columbia.

Residency Training: Physicians must have completed residency training, approved by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs in an accredited core specialty training program leading to eligibility for board certification.

(NOTE: VA physicians involved in academic training programs may be required to be board certified for faculty status.) Approved residencies are: (1) Those approved by the accrediting bodies for graduate medical education, the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME) or American Osteopathic Association (AOA), in the list published for the year the residency, or fellowship if applicable, was completed; OR (2) One year of post medical school training (internship, first year of residency, or transitional year residency) approved by ACGME or AOA followed by two years of post-training independent practice (performing under a full and unrestricted license) in the United States; OR (3) Non-US residency training programs followed by a minimum of three years of verified independent practice in the United States (performing under a full and unrestricted license) performing duties related to the position they are applying for (United States fellowships would be creditable towards this requirement), which the local Medical Staff Executive Committee deems to have provided the applicant with appropriate professional training and believes has exposed the Physician to an appropriate range of patient care experiences.

Exceptions: Residents currently enrolled in ACGME/AOA accredited residency training programs and who would otherwise meet the basic requirements for appointment are eligible to be appointed as "Physician Resident Providers" (PRPs).

PRPs must be fully licensed physicians (i.e., not a training license) and may only be appointed on an intermittent basis. PRPs are not considered independent practitioners and will not be privileged; rather, they are to have a "scope of practice" that allows them to perform certain restricted duties under supervision.

Additionally, surgery residents in gap years may also be appointed as PRPs.

In rare and unusual circumstances, the Facility Director can submit a memo to the VISN Director through the VISN Chief Medical Officer, who may approve requests for reasonable exceptions to the residency training requirement for Physicians whose composite record of experience, accomplishments, performance, and qualifications warrant such action.

Board Certification.

Physicians are generally not required to be board certified for employment in VA; however, three circumstances in VA require Physician board certification: If the position being filled is required to be a supervisor for medical students or Physician residents (including fellows), the LCME, ACGME, or AOA standards requiring a particular board certification credential will apply.

If the position being filled will have faculty status with an affiliated medical school (for example, in joint recruitments with affiliated medical schools), then a medical school requirement for board certification will apply to the jointly recruited position.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued.

Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

GitLab is an open-core software company that develops the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps, used by more than 100,000 organizations and 50 million people. Our mission is to unlock every team to ship trusted software at the speed of imagination.
Software is increasingly built by machines and directed by people. When agentic coding tools accelerate without context, governance, and lifecycle control, teams get speed with chaos. GitLab enables speed with control: customers deploy agents across the software development lifecycle (SDLC) with the orchestration, context, security, and governance to ship trusted software at scale.
The same principles show up in how we work. We build a culture of excellence around Speed with Quality, Ownership Mindset, and Customer Outcomes, and we treat AI as a core productivity multiplier. Every team member is expected to put AI into daily workflows to move faster without losing control. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued.

As Principal Program Manager, Go-To-Market, you own two equal pillars of go-to-market execution for Product & Technical Marketing (PTM). First, you are the strategic and hands-on architect behind GitLab's high-stakes minor and major launches, redesigning the launch operating model with AI agents at its core so customers discover, adopt, and experience GitLab with precision.
Second, you run program management on key initiatives that span Product Management and Product Design through Growth Marketing, Comms and Social, and Field Enablement, wherever those motions depend on PTM. PTM team is responsible for product and solutions marketing, technical writing and documentation, developer advocacy, and globalization, and acts as the glue between these functions across a variety of go-to-market initiatives.
You are AI-first by default. When programs still run on many manual steps, you convert that work into team-wide AI workflows, either by shipping the automations yourself or by partnering with the AI Transformation Owner (ATO) for the marketing organization to drive shared skills, adoption, and governance. You are not a reactive deadline chaser.

You drive solutions with stakeholders as dates approach, design decision stages so tradeoffs land early, and redesign stages and workflows when product roadmap, growth priorities, or major launch decisions change. You create clarity in ambiguity: frame the problem, present options and tradeoffs, name owners, and optimize for decision velocity.
In your first year, you institutionalize a dual operating system: a scalable launch framework for 15+ minor and major launches per year, and a portfolio program practice that maps dependencies from Product and Design through PTM into Growth, Comms, and Field. You ship production agent workflows that cut manual coordination, establish benchmarks for quality, and make go-to-market program management achieve relevance in the AI era, and become a trusted partner across the organization.
Reporting to the VP of Product & Technical Marketing, you operate with significant executive visibility and autonomy. You measure success by what lands for customers and the business: pipeline where it matters, and brand and community impact where business requires it, not by activity volume alone.

At Olsson, we are passionate about improving communities through expert engineering and design. Our people are our greatest asset, and we are committed to creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and make an impact.
Our Data Center team delivers multidisciplinary engineering and design services for some of the world's most innovative companies. These projects represent some of the largest and most complex infrastructure developments in the country, creating opportunities to solve challenging problems, collaborate across disciplines, and shape the facilities that support global connectivity.
We are seeking a Project Manager to lead the Short Circuit, Coordination, and Arc Flash (SCCAF) process for complex data center projects. In this role, you will bring clients, contractors, and technical teams together around the information, decisions, and milestones needed to deliver coordinated electrical studies.

You will help move the work from kickoff through final reports and labels while supporting system reliability, personnel safety, and a smooth transition from design into construction.

Serve as the primary point of contact for SCCAF coordination among the client, general contractor, electrical contractor, and Olsson engineering team.
Lead the SCCAF process from project kickoff through final reports and labels, keeping the work aligned with construction milestones and project priorities.
Develop and maintain a detailed SCCAF schedule, adjusting it as project information, equipment data, and construction activities evolve.
Coordinate the flow of SCCAF information and deliverables, including requests for information, submittals, equipment data, settings, labels, study revisions, and final reports.
Track required inputs and follow up with project partners to address missing information, field discrepancies, late design changes, or other items that may affect progress.
Plan, lead, and document SCCAF coordination meetings while maintaining clear action items, responsibilities, and follow-up.
Partner with technical teams to support quality, consistency, and alignment between SCCAF deliverables and approved construction documents.
Identify schedule, coordination, and project delivery risks early and work with stakeholders to develop practical solutions.
Support project management activities, including deliverable tracking, document control, invoicing coordination, project reporting, and adherence to Olsson's quality processes.

Täglich fahren Millionen Autos durch Deutschland, und in den meisten bleibt Platz ungenutzt. Wir ändern das.
MUVN ist ein digitaler Transportmarktplatz. Wir bringen Fahrer:innen mit freiem Laderaum mit Menschen und Unternehmen zusammen, die etwas transportieren müssen. Günstiger, versichert, ohne Umweg.
Wir bauen gerade an mehreren Dingen gleichzeitig: einem neuen Produkt für gewerbliche Versender, Piloten mit großen Marken, neuen Strecken, Integrationen. An jedem dieser Themen arbeiten mehrere Menschen aus mehreren Bereichen, und keiner von ihnen hat den vollen Überblick über alle anderen.
Genau dafür gibt es diese Stelle. Du weißt zu jeder Zeit, wo jedes Projekt steht, was als Nächstes ansteht und wo es gerade klemmt. Eine Frage zum aktuellen Sprint, und du kannst sie beantworten. Eine Frage zu einem Partnerprojekt, und du gehst auf die Leute zu und sorgst dafür, dass am Tag X alles steht.
Du bist kein Product Owner und musst nicht entwickeln können. Du musst verstehen, worum es geht, grob einschätzen können, was etwas bedeutet, und Dinge über die Ziellinie bringen.
Hierfür suchen wir dich ab dem 01.10.2026 als Verstärkung für unser Team in Hamburg 🚀
Aufgaben
Überblick über alle Projekte
Du führst die Timeline über Marktplatz, unser Produkt für gewerbliche Versender, Integrationen und Partnerprojekte. Status, nächster Meilenstein, offene Entscheidungen, Risiken. Alles an einem Ort, aktuell, und für jeden im Team in zwei Minuten auffindbar.
Themen aktiv vorantreiben
Du wartest nicht auf Statusmeldungen, du holst sie dir. Freundlich und hartnäckig, bis erledigt wirklich erledigt heißt.
Abhängigkeiten und Termine
Du erkennst früh, wo sich Themen gegenseitig blockieren, über Tech, Marketing, Operations und externe Partner hinweg. Und du eskalierst konkret: nicht "das wird knapp", sondern "wenn X bis Freitag nicht steht, verschiebt sich Y um zwei Wochen".
Launches und Piloten
Du planst und begleitest den Start neuer Produkte, Features und Partnerprojekte. Wer liefert was bis wann, was muss am Tag X stehen, was lernen wir danach. Und du baust Checklisten, die beim zweiten Mal besser funktionieren als beim ersten.
Schnittstelle zu Tech
Wir sind ein technisches Produkt, deshalb hängt vieles an unserem CTO. Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen ihm und den laufenden Projekten. Du verstehst genug vom Thema, um in einem Kunden- oder Partnergespräch grob einzuschätzen, was etwas bedeutet, und um die richtige Rückfrage zu stellen.
Ziele und Rhythmus
Du hältst den Takt: Zyklen, Check-ins, Reviews, sichtbarer Fortschritt. Die Ziele setzen die Gründer:innen und die Verantwortlichen. Dass sie nachgehalten werden, liegt bei dir.
Meetings und Entscheidungen
Für deine projektübergreifenden Runden bereitest du vor und nach: Agenda, Unterlagen, Ergebnisse, To-dos mit Verantwortlichem und Datum. Entscheidungen dokumentierst du so, dass sie zwei Wochen später nicht neu verhandelt werden.
Externe Partner
Agenturen, Pilotpartner, Dienstleister. Du steuerst die Zusammenarbeit: Lieferungen, Termine, Feedbackschleifen.
Prozesse und KI
Wiederkehrendes standardisierst du mit Vorlagen und Checklisten. Du arbeitest KI-first: Statusberichte, Protokolle, Recherche und Dokumentation baust du mit KI. Was dabei rauskommt, prüfst du. Die Richtigkeit gehört dir, nicht dem Tool.
Qualifikation
Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im Projekt- oder Programmmanagement, gerne in einem Startup, einer Agentur oder einem digitalen Produktumfeld. Du hast schon einmal ein Projekt mit mehreren Beteiligten und einem harten Termin über die Ziellinie gebracht, ohne selbst die fachliche Arbeit gemacht zu haben.
Du bist nah dran an digitalen Produkten. Tiefe Technikkenntnisse brauchst du nicht, aber du musst Sachzusammenhänge verstehen und grob einschätzen können, was ein Wunsch bedeutet, bevor du ihn zusagst.

Build with us
Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.
Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.
With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.
We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.
Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

As Implementation Manager, you'll own the post-sales integration phase for Mollie's largest and most complex deals, guiding merchants from handover through testing to go live. You'll run kickoffs with internal and external stakeholders, set go live dates, keep progress on track, and coordinate testing and feedback along the way. You'll work closely with colleagues across sales, product and engineering, as well as with merchants directly, keeping everyone aligned as deals move toward launch.
This function is newly formed, so you'll have real influence over how the role and its processes take shape, bringing in your own experience rather than following a fixed playbook. The role is also more technical than it might first appear: you'll get close to the real world edge cases and issues that surface once a solution meets implementation reality, giving you hands on technical exposure without needing a payments or engineering background going in.
You'll be part of the team's expansion into new markets, starting with Italy. Your work protects revenue by keeping live dates on track, and it supports how Mollie scales delivery more broadly, building a structured, dedicated integration phase for its biggest deals. You'll report to Jan-Jaap van Helden.
What you'll ship
Own the post sales integration phase for Mollie's largest and most complex deals, from handover through testing to go live
Run kickoffs with internal and external stakeholders, setting go live dates and keeping progress on track
Organise and track testing, raising issues and feedback as they surface
Coordinate across sales, product and engineering colleagues, as well as with merchants directly, to keep everyone aligned
Keep agreed go live dates on track, since delays mean missed revenue
Maintain documentation and playbooks that make delivery predictable and scalable

Up to 3 years of experience in ecommerce or payments, in a similar role
Fluent in Italian and English, since this role supports the Italian market and works directly with local merchants
Strong organisational and structuring skills, with solid project management ability
Genuine technical interest and the ability to understand technical concepts such as APIs, since this role gets close to the edge cases that surface once a solution meets reality
An ownership mindset, taking charge of the implementation process rather than reacting to it, while staying flexible within agreed roles and processes
Honest, open communication style with a genuine, trustworthy manner, including a strong track record collaborating with pre-sales teams and handling conflict at handover
Payments or ecommerce experience, or familiarity with the ecosystem, is a strong plus though not required
Grow your way
At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.
You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.
No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.
Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy
If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

## About Our Client ##
Notre client est une PME industrielle suisse spécialisée dans la fabrication de composants de haute précision pour des secteurs exigeants tels que l'aéronautique, le médical, l'horlogerie et l'automobile. Dans un contexte de croissance et d'évolution de ses processus, l'entreprise souhaite renforcer son équipe de direction avec un Responsable Qualité capable de faire évoluer durablement son système qualité.
## Job Description ##
**Vos responsabilités en tant que :**
* Piloter et faire évoluer le système de management de la qualité.
* Garantir la conformité aux normes ISO 9001 et EN/AS 9100.
* Structurer les processus qualité et renforcer leur intégration dans les opérations.
* Développer une culture d'amélioration continue auprès des équipes.
* Piloter les audits internes, clients et de certification.
* Suivre les indicateurs qualité, les non-conformités et les actions correctives.
* Collaborer étroitement avec la Production, les Méthodes et la R&D.
* Garantir les moyens et procédures de contrôle nécessaires à la conformité des produits.
* Accompagner l'évolution du système qualité dans le cadre de la migration vers un nouvel ERP.
* Participer aux projets liés aux futures certifications, notamment ISO 14001.
* Manager et développer une équipe de 6 personnes.
* Participer aux décisions stratégiques en tant que membre du comité de direction.
## The Successful Applicant ##
Le profil idéal du Manager Qualité
* 8 ans d'expérience minimum en qualité dans un environnement industriel.
* Expérience confirmée dans la mise en place, la structuration ou l'amélioration d'un système qualité.
* Très bonne maîtrise des normes ISO 9001 et EN/AS 9100.
* Une expérience dans l'aéronautique est fortement privilégiée ; une expérience dans le médical est également très appréciée.
* Bonne compréhension des environnements de production et des problématiques techniques industrielles.
* Anglais B2 minimum.
**Ce qui fera la différence**
Nous recherchons une personne pragmatique, autonome et capable de challenger l'existant.
Vous savez appliquer les normes avec rigueur tout en gardant une approche proche du terrain et des réalités industrielles. Votre capacité à fédérer les équipes et à faire évoluer les pratiques sera essentielle.
## What's on Offer ##
* Un rôle stratégique au comité de direction.
* Le management d'une équipe de 6 personnes.
* Un environnement industriel de haute précision.
* Une forte exposition aux secteurs aéronautique et médical.
* Un réel périmètre d'action pour faire évoluer le système qualité.
* Une entreprise familiale en croissance, avec une vision à long terme.

Dropbox is looking for a Program Manager, Customers to build the connective layer between EPD and GTM as we test products, evolve the platform, and learn from our managed customer base. This role will plan, recruit, launch, engage, measure, and close out customer programs while maintaining clear product-readiness standards and a strong customer experience.
The role is execution-focused but broad in scope. The immediate priority is creating a scalable way to test pre-PMF products with existing managed customers, including priority programs. Over time, the role will support additional customer-facing EPD initiatives, help relaunch and operate Dropbox’s Customer Advisory Board, integrate customer testing into launch processes, and establish repeatable playbooks that can be adopted by functional owners.
You will work closely with Product, Design, Research, PMM, Launch Ops, Customer Marketing, CS, Sales, Brand Studio, Community, and Analytics. You will have substantial cross-functional exposure and the opportunity to turn customer participation into clearer product decisions, stronger launch readiness, and a closed insight loop back into product and GTM.

Stand up and run repeatable customer programs, including planning, recruitment, onboarding, engagement, measurement, closeout, and transition to the long-term owning team.
Create shared operating infrastructure, including intake processes, recruitment and readiness criteria, briefs, templates, playbooks, status reporting, feedback tracking, escalation paths, and a single source of truth.
Coordinate Product, Design, Research, PMM, Launch Ops, Customer Marketing, CS, Sales, Brand Studio, Community, and Analytics around shared plans, decisions, milestones, and handoffs.
Own the execution of pre-PMF customer testing through H2, including product evaluation, messaging feedback, phased-rollout support, measurement, and exit criteria.
Support the relaunch and ongoing operation of Dropbox’s Customer Advisory Board through recruitment, cadence management, agenda design, and synthesis for senior leaders and partner teams.
Integrate customer testing into the product-launch process as a readiness gate or stage, partnering with PMM and Launch Ops as the process matures.
Establish recurring customer listening and insight-loop practices that connect customer-support signals, VoC, UXR, managed-customer feedback, and S-team engagement back into EPD and GTM decision-making.

8+ years of program management, operations, customer research operations, product operations, go-to-market operations, or a related field with experience delivering complex cross-functional programs.
Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous customer-facing initiative from planning through execution, measurement, closeout, and handoff.
Experience coordinating multiple teams with different goals, dependencies, and decision rights while maintaining clear ownership and follow-through.
Strong operating discipline: able to create practical processes, readiness criteria, documentation, reporting rhythms, and repeatable playbooks.
Experience working directly with customers or customer-facing teams, including recruiting participants, managing engagement, gathering feedback, and protecting customer experience.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs into clear recommendations and decisions.
Sound judgment about product readiness, customer participation, confidentiality, escalation, and when to protect learning quality over premature storytelling or account-driven requests.

Experience with pre-PMF product testing, beta or Design Partner programs, Customer Advisory Boards, Voice of Customer, user research operations, or customer advocacy programs.
Experience embedding customer feedback or testing into product-launch, launch-readiness, or product-operations processes.

**Contexte**
Dans le cadre du renforcement de sa feuille de route Cybersécurité, notre client, un groupe international basé en Suisse, recherche un **Chef de Projet GRC Senior** pour rejoindre son organisation IT / Cybersécurité.
Le consultant interviendra au sein d-une équipe **Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)** et aura pour mission de cadrer, piloter et coordonner plusieurs projets transverses liés à la gouvernance, aux risques, à la conformité et à la cybersécurité.
Le rôle nécessite une forte capacité de structuration, de coordination et de communication avec des interlocuteurs IT, métiers et fonctions support.
**Responsabilités**
Cadrage et planification du portefeuille projets
* Prendre en main le contexte, les travaux existants, les parties prenantes et les dépendances.
* Formaliser les **Project Charters** : objectifs, périmètre, gouvernance, responsabilités, livrables, jalons et critères de succès.
* Construire et maintenir une roadmap consolidée du portefeuille.
* Identifier les priorités, capacités, dépendances et chemins critiques.
* Mettre en place les outils de pilotage et assurer leur maintien à jour.
Pilotage opérationnel des projets GRC
* Élaborer et suivre les plans projets, jalons, charges, actions, risques, problèmes et décisions.
* Coordonner les équipes internes, externes et les différentes parties prenantes.
* Organiser et animer les comités projets, ateliers et réunions de coordination.
* Identifier les dérives et assurer les alertes auprès des parties prenantes concernées.
* Préparer les décisions, arbitrages et plans d'actions.
* Assurer le suivi du cycle de vie des livrables : production, revue, validation, versioning et archivage.
Reporting et suivi des activités RUN
* Produire une vision consolidée de l-avancement du portefeuille.
* Assurer le reporting auprès du management et des instances de gouvernance.
* Suivre notamment les indicateurs d-avancement, planning, capacité, risques, dépendances, actions et décisions.
* Consolider les indicateurs liés aux activités récurrentes de l-équipe GRC.
* Identifier les écarts et suivre les actions correctives jusqu-à leur clôture.
Qualité, audit et conformité
* Mettre en cohérence les objectifs des projets, contrôles attendus, preuves et plans de remédiation.
* Préparer des dossiers de preuves structurés et réutilisables pour les revues internes et externes.
* Assurer le suivi des actions issues des audits et constats jusqu-à leur clôture.
* Veiller à la qualité et à la traçabilité de la documentation projet.
Conduite du changement et passage en RUN
* Coordonner les besoins de communication et d-adoption avec les équipes concernées.
* Préparer et organiser le passage des projets en RUN.
* Réaliser les clôtures de projets et documenter les résultats, risques résiduels et actions restantes.
**Profil recherché**
Nous recherchons un profil **confirmé à senior**, disposant de **plus de 7 ans d-expérience** en gestion de projets ou programmes IT, idéalement dans les domaines de la **cybersécurité, GRC, risques ou conformité**.

* Une expérience avérée du pilotage simultané de plusieurs projets transverses.
* Une bonne compréhension des enjeux de **cybersécurité, gouvernance, gestion des risques, audit et conformité**.
* Une solide capacité à structurer des projets complexes et à coordonner de multiples parties prenantes.
* Une expérience significative de préparation et d-animation de comités, workshops et instances de gouvernance.
* Une bonne maîtrise du reporting à destination du management et des instances dirigeantes.
* Une maîtrise des pratiques de gestion de projet : planning, risques, dépendances, RAID log, gouvernance, change management, suivi des actions.
* Une expérience dans un environnement réglementé ou soumis à des exigences de contrôle et d-audit.
* Une excellente capacité de communication et de synthèse.

**Certification ITIL v4 obligatoire**, ou engagement à l'obtenir dans les quatre premiers mois de la mission.

* Scrum / SAFe

Xsolla is looking for a Senior Delivery Manager to help bring greater clarity, coordination, and operational discipline across our product development teams.
This role sits at the center of product execution, working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Analytics, Marketing, and other Delivery Managers to ensure teams are aligned on priorities, dependencies, timelines, and changes.
The Senior Delivery Manager will own the operating rhythm of the team: maintaining the backlog and roadmap, running engineering ceremonies, surfacing risks and blockers, and ensuring that changes are communicated clearly—not just what is changing, but why.
Beyond day-to-day delivery, this person will also play an important role in identifying broader operational challenges and working with leadership to improve how the team plans, communicates, prioritizes, and executes.

Cross-Functional Alignment
Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Analytics, Marketing, Project Managers, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment across initiatives.
Maintain visibility into dependencies, timelines, priorities, and risks across teams.
Proactively identify areas where teams are becoming misaligned and drive the conversations necessary to resolve them.
Ensure stakeholders understand both what the team is doing and how individual activities connect to broader product and business priorities.
Team Execution & Scrum
Run and facilitate engineering scrum ceremonies, including stand-ups, sprint planning, refinement, retrospectives, and other working sessions as needed.
Ensure teams leave meetings with clear decisions, owners, and next steps.
Track blockers and risks through resolution rather than simply documenting them.
Help create a predictable and effective operating cadence between Product and Engineering.
Backlog & Roadmap Management
Build, maintain, and continuously improve the team backlog and roadmap in partnership with Product and Engineering leadership.
Ensure work is clearly prioritized, appropriately structured, and visible to stakeholders.
Maintain clarity between committed roadmap work, future opportunities, operational improvements, and unscheduled backlog items.
Identify dependencies, sequencing challenges, and resource conflicts before they become delivery issues.
Change Management & Communication
Communicate changes to priorities, timelines, scope, and direction clearly and proactively.
Help teams understand the why behind changes so that Engineers, Designers, and other stakeholders have the context necessary to make better decisions.
Ensure important decisions and changes are documented and communicated consistently across impacted teams.
Help reduce confusion caused by fragmented or inconsistent communication.
Operational Improvement
Identify recurring execution challenges, process breakdowns, organizational friction, and operational gaps.
Work with leadership to understand root causes and define strategies for addressing them.
Translate operational strategies into actionable improvements for the team.
Continuously evaluate how planning, prioritization, communication, and execution processes can be improved.
Encourage accountability across teams and help ensure problems are driven toward resolution rather than passed between functions.
What Success Looks Like
Success in this role means teams have greater clarity and predictability in how they operate.

s.h: The right candidate will help create an environment where
s.t:

Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, and Marketing remain aligned as plans evolve.

s.h: Roadmaps and backlogs accurately reflect the work of the team.
s.t:
Risks and dependencies are surfaced early rather than discovered late.
Changes are communicated clearly and with appropriate context.
Meetings result in decisions and action rather than additional ambiguity.
Operational problems are identified proactively and systematically improved.
Leadership has confidence in the team’s ability to execute against its commitments.

Strong Communication
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
Able to communicate effectively across technical, product, creative, and business teams.
Comfortable facilitating discussions involving competing priorities or viewpoints.
Able to simplify complex situations and provide teams with clear direction and context.
Highly Organized
Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, dependencies, stakeholders, and timelines simultaneously.
Strong attention to detail while maintaining awareness of broader strategic priorities.
Comfortable creating structure in environments where processes or responsibilities may not yet be clearly defined.
Diligent & Proactive
Does not wait for problems to become urgent before addressing them.
Proactively identifies risks, gaps, dependencies, and areas of confusion.
Consistently follows through on decisions, commitments, and open items.
Takes ownership of driving issues toward resolution.
Strategic & Operational Thinking
Able to distinguish between isolated execution problems and broader systemic challenges.
Comfortable working with leadership to improve how teams operate.
Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to identify root causes rather than treating symptoms.
Able to balance immediate delivery needs with longer-term improvements to team effectiveness.

Significant experience in Project Management, Program Management, Product Operations, or a similar role within a technology or software organization.
Experience working closely with Product Management and Engineering teams.
Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum development practices.
Experience managing product roadmaps, engineering backlogs, and cross-functional dependencies.
Experience working in complex organizations with multiple teams and stakeholders.
Experience in gaming, payments, e-commerce, or technology platforms is a plus.

As Biogen ’s Associate Director, Access Management Service Delivery- Cyber Security, you are the Access Management subject matter expert and services leader for all Access Management activities at Biogen . This role is accountable for delivering value to global stakeholders – which includes access services to every application in Biogen .

A peer to this role is the Service Delivery Manager of Identity. This role is a direct report of the Global Leader of Identity and Access Management and is a member of the extended leadership team within the Cybersecurity organization.
As Associate Director, Access Management Service Delivery, you are responsible for establishing access management policies and standards and keeping them current.

You are responsible for the planning and execution of initiatives that improve access management capabilities – both central platforms or efforts supporting independent stakeholder applications.

This role is responsible for the entire service delivery process, from planning and implementing service strategies to monitoring and reporting on service performance. Long-term, the largest lever to improve service delivery is through automation into target applications.

While >95% of access transactions originate through our Biogen Access Management (BAM) platform, less than 25% are fulfilled through automation. In other words, 75% of requests require manual fulfillment by independent application teams.

In the near-term, this role will work with their peer in Identity to automate the onboarding, lifecycle and deprovisioning of all types of privileged accounts. This is done manually today via BAM requests and for security’s sake, deserves to be automated.

A long-term objective for this role is to work with the application owners across Biogen to adopt access automation. This role manages the performance of an integrated team, ensuring that service delivery meets or exceeds stakeholder expectations.

You will serve as the business process owner for access management policy, standards and processes which includes:
Authorization (Permissions): Determining what an authenticated user is allowed to do. Common models include:
RBAC (Role-Based): Access granted based on job functions (e.g., "HR Manager").
ABAC (Attribute-Based): Access based on dynamic factors like location, time of day, or device security posture.
Administration (Lifecycle Management): Managing the full lifespan of a digital identity, from provisioning (creation) and maintenance (role changes) to deprovisioning (deletion when a user leaves). Auditing & Reporting (Accountability): Tracking and recording user activities to maintain a clear audit trail.

Continuous measurement and planning
Establish stakeholder credibility with thoughtful planning.
Identify what processes and/or manual transactions to improve and execute – largely through standards and automation.
Proven via metrics and working with stakeholders, prioritize opportunities with existing processes, service lines and technologies, build project plans, enhancements and ad hoc operational plans that are realistic and exceed the expectations of stakeholders.
Plans account for business/customer needs, user experience, and sets up the performing units/teams for success by sizing the complexity and effort accurately.
Execution
Own and drive forward projects, enhancements, and be the responsible owner for addressing ad-hoc operational “issues” - responsible and accountable for managing
Establishing realistic timelines
Deliverables
Resource Management
Change Management
Stakeholder Management
Stakeholder, Risk Management and Problem Solving
Working cross-functionally as the access management SME to support needs of stakeholder projects, enhancement and operational matters that arise across our global IAM ecosystem. Anticipate and work through risks and ad hoc issues that always arise with complex infrastructures
This includes command and control of major incidents that arise impacting core service lines
Policy and standards setting – Enforcing compliance
Establish policies, procedures, and standards – keep them current through periodic review and change management. Establish appropriate KPIs and measure compliance. Support regulatory requirements (ie. SOX, GxP) and direct/indirect audits.

When the predominant work involves air carrier maintenance applicants for Aviation Safety Inspector (Maintenance) positions must meet all of the following requirements: Experience involving the maintenance and repair of airframes, power plants, and systems of multi-engine aircraft of more than 12,500 pounds maximum certificated takeoff weight maintained under an airworthiness maintenance and inspection program.

Du hast bereits in einer Agentur gearbeitet , behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Kundenprojekten den Überblick und fühlst dich zwischen Kundenmeeting, Contentproduktion und Projektplanung wohl?
Dann suchen wir dich als Projektmanager (m/w/d) für unser Team bei wirdenkenlokal .
Wir sind Medienhaus und Agentur mit Sitz in Nürnberg und unterstützen Unternehmen dabei, sichtbar zu werden , neue Kunden zu erreichen und passende Mitarbeitende zu gewinnen . Dafür entwickeln und realisieren wir Projekte rund um Social Media, Video- und Fotoproduktion, Onlinekampagnen, PR und Events .
Für die Steuerung unserer Kundenprojekte suchen wir jemanden, der Verantwortung übernimmt , strukturiert arbeitet und gleichzeitig versteht, dass Agenturalltag nicht immer nach Lehrbuch läuft.
Aufgaben
Projektmanagement: Du übernimmst die eigenständige Steuerung unserer Agenturprojekte – von der Planung über die Koordination der Umsetzung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Dabei betreust du Social-Media-Projekte, Videoproduktionen, Fotoshootings und weitere Online-Marketing-Kampagnen.
Kundenbetreuung & Beratung: Du bist eine zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden, führst regelmäßige Kundentermine und berätst sie entlang unseres Leistungsportfolios. Du verstehst, was der Kunde erreichen möchte, übersetzt Anforderungen in konkrete Aufgaben und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Team passende Lösungen.
Koordination & Überblick: Mehrere Kunden, unterschiedliche Deadlines und verschiedene interne Ansprechpartner gleichzeitig? Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel. Du priorisierst Aufgaben, koordinierst Timings und Ressourcen und sorgst dafür, dass alle Beteiligten wissen, was wann zu tun ist.
Contentproduktionen: Du bist nicht nur am Schreibtisch: Bei ausgewählten Video- und Fotoproduktionen unterstützt du unser Team vor Ort, koordinierst Abläufe und stellst gemeinsam mit unseren Kreativen sicher, dass die Anforderungen des Kunden umgesetzt werden.
Schnittstelle zwischen Kunde und Team: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Social-Media-Managern, Videografen, Fotografen und weiteren Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen. Informationen, Feedback und Freigaben laufen bei dir zusammen und werden von dir strukturiert weitergegeben.
Projektmanagement mit Awork: Wir organisieren unsere Projekte mit Awork. Du musst das Tool noch nicht kennen – Erfahrung mit Projektmanagement-Tools wie Awork, Asana, Monday, Trello oder vergleichbaren Lösungen setzen wir allerdings voraus.
KI & Prozessoptimierung: Wir nutzen KI bereits intensiv in unserem Arbeitsalltag und wollen das weiter ausbauen. Du bist offen dafür, KI-Tools sowohl innerhalb von Kundenprojekten als auch zur Optimierung unserer internen Prozesse einzusetzen, neue Möglichkeiten auszuprobieren und bestehende Abläufe kontinuierlich besser zu machen.
Qualifikation
Agenturerfahrung: Du hast bereits in einer Marketing-, Social-Media-, Digital-, Content- oder vergleichbaren Agentur gearbeitet und kennst die Dynamik des Agenturalltags.
Erfahrung im Online-Marketing: Du bringst praktische Vorerfahrung und ein gutes Verständnis für Social Media, Contentproduktion und Onlinekampagnen mit. Du musst nicht alles selbst umsetzen können – aber du solltest verstehen, wie gute Projekte in diesen Bereichen geplant und realisiert werden.
Organisationstalent: Du kannst mehrere Kundenprojekte gleichzeitig steuern, Prioritäten setzen und verlierst auch dann nicht den Überblick, wenn an einem Tag fünf Dinge gleichzeitig passieren.
Stressresistenz: Wenn es turbulent wird, wirst du nicht hektisch, sondern fokussiert. Du kannst mit Zeitdruck, kurzfristigen Änderungen und intensiveren Projektphasen umgehen und läufst dann eher zur Höchstform auf, als den Überblick zu verlieren.
Kommunikationsstärke: Eine klare, professionelle und zielführende Kommunikation – schriftlich wie mündlich – setzen wir voraus. Du kannst sowohl souverän mit Kunden kommunizieren als auch intern klare Briefings und Aufgaben formulieren.
Eigenverantwortung: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand jeden nächsten Schritt vorgibt. Du erkennst, was zu tun ist, sprichst Probleme frühzeitig an und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Projekte.
Interesse an Marketing & Medien: Social Media, Marketing, Medien und digitale Kommunikation interessieren dich auch über deine unmittelbaren Aufgaben hinaus. Du willst verstehen, welche Plattformen, Formate und Entwicklungen gerade relevant sind.
Offenheit für KI: ChatGPT, Claude und andere KI-Tools sind für dich keine Bedrohung, sondern Werkzeuge. Du hast Lust darauf, herauszufinden, wie wir damit bessere Ergebnisse erzielen und effizienter arbeiten können.

Abwechslung statt immer gleicher Projekte: Vom regionalen Mittelständler bis zum Konzern, von Social-Media-Betreuung über Recruitingkampagnen bis zur Videoproduktion: Du arbeitest mit Kunden aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen und an sehr unterschiedlichen Projekten.
Du siehst, was deine Arbeit bewirkt: Unsere Projekte sollen nicht einfach nur gut aussehen. Wir helfen Unternehmen dabei, sichtbarer zu werden, neue Kunden zu erreichen und passende Mitarbeitende zu gewinnen – insbesondere Unternehmen aus unserer Region.
Ein Arbeitsplatz mit Aussicht: Unser Büro befindet sich im Business Tower Nürnberg – in einem der höchsten Büros der Region.
Kurze Wege & flache Hierarchien: Du arbeitest in einem Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem nahbaren Führungsteam. Gute Ideen müssen bei uns nicht erst durch fünf Hierarchieebenen.
Moderne Arbeitsweise: Wir arbeiten digital, nutzen moderne Projektmanagement- und KI-Tools und entwickeln unsere internen Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter.
Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten gehören für uns genauso dazu wie die notwendige Flexibilität, die ein abwechslungsreicher Agenturalltag manchmal mit sich bringt.
Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Wir wachsen als Unternehmen weiter – und damit entstehen auch für dich Möglichkeiten, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.
